description: JavaScript source code for a TodoMVC application using jQuery, Handlebars, and Router. Implements task management features including create, edit, delete, toggle, and filter todos.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application object managing todo list interactions, rendering, and event bindings.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the app, loads todos, compiles templates, binds events, and sets up routing.

methods.name: bindEvents
methods.description: Binds DOM events to handler functions for user interactions.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the todo list and updates UI elements based on current state.

methods.name: renderFooter
methods.description: Renders the footer with todo counts and filter options.

methods.name: toggleAll
methods.description: Toggles completion status of all todos.

methods.name: getActiveTodos
methods.description: Returns list of todos not completed.

methods.name: getFilteredTodos
methods.description: Returns todos filtered by current filter ('all', 'active', 'completed').

methods.name: indexFromEl
methods.description: Finds index of todo based on DOM element.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles completion status of a specific todo.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Enables editing mode for a todo.

methods.name: editKeyup
methods.description: Handles keyup events during editing, including Enter and Escape keys.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a todo's title or deletes it if empty.
